name: Hide n Seek
summary: Step into the ultimate VR hide-and-seek adventure! In this immersive game, you can take on the role of the seeker or the hider, depending on the chosen mode. As the seeker, your mission is clear: track down and tag all hiders before the timer runs out. But if you're a hider, your goal is survival—find the perfect spot and avoid being caught at all costs until time is up.
